notes.glasses: Glasses with thick or colored frames, sunglasses, or tinted lenses are prohibited. Flash reflection on lenses is rejected.
notes.smile: Neutral expression, mouth closed, direct forward gaze.
notes.ears: Hair must not obscure eyebrows, eyes, or facial contours.
notes.shadows: No shadows on facial surface or background.
notes.babyRules: Infants should face forward with eyes open. No hands or support pillows in frame.
